shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' -g '"'!pnpm-lock.yaml'"' -g '"'!yarn.lock'"' -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g 'src/**' -g 'app/**' -g 'pages/**' -g 'index.html' -g 'vite.config.*' -g 'tsconfig.json' -g '.agents/skills/gravity-ui/**'"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md'

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,100p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && cat vite.config.ts && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md"

/bin/bash -lc ".agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button TextInput Select Switch Checkbox Avatar ThemeProvider Icon && sed -n '1,150p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/icons.md"

/bin/bash -lc "bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button TextInput Select Switch Checkbox Avatar ThemeProvider Icon && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md && sed -n '1,150p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/icons.md"
/bin/bash -lc "npm view @gravity-ui/navigation version peerDependencies && rg --files -g '*lock*' -g '"'!node_modules'"' && cat index.html && cat tsconfig.json"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install @gravity-ui/navigation@7.1.3 @gravity-ui/icons@''^2.2.0 @bem-react/classname@''^1.6.0'

/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/types.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -C 3 'base-background|base-float|text-primary|text-secondary|line-generic|brand|spacing|border-radius' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md | head -160; curl -Ls https://gravity-ui.com/icons -o /tmp/gravity-icons.html; python - <<'PY'
import re
s=open('/tmp/gravity-icons.html').read()
for match in re.finditer(r'.{0,40}(?:House|Person|Gear|Bell|Shield|Envelope|ArrowUp|CircleQuestion|Chevron|Folder|Layout|Magnifier|ArrowRightFromSquare|Globe).{0,80}',s):
 print(match.group(0)[:150])
PY"

/bin/bash -lc "bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh navigation AsideHeader && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/README.md && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation | rg '(AsideHeader|types|Logo).*d.ts"'$'"' | head -25 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/types/main.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | head -150"

/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module -e 'const s=await (await fetch(\"https://gravity-ui.com/icons\")).text();const names=[...new Set(s.match(/(?:House|Person|Gear|Bell|Shield|Envelope|ArrowUp|CircleQuestion|Chevron|Folder|Layout|Magnifier|ArrowRightFromSquare|Globe|CircleCheck|Lock|ArrowDownToLine|CirclePlus|ArrowShape)[A-Za-z]*/g))];console.log(names.join(\"\\n\"))' && node -p 'JSON.stringify({icons:require(\"@gravity-ui/icons/package.json\").version,navigation:require(\"@gravity-ui/navigation/package.json\").version})'"

/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/INDEX.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/Logo/Logo.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.css | head -100'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'House|Person|Gear|Bell|Shield|Envelope|ArrowUpFromLine|CircleQuestion|Chevron|Folder|Layout|Magnifier|ArrowRightFromSquare|Globe|CircleCheck|Lock|ArrowShape|Bars' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/esm/index.d.ts | head -65; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar | head -15; rg -n -- '--g-text-input|--g-button|--g-select' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -30; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/README.md | head -65; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/types/common.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/AvatarImage/AvatarImage.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -C 3 'CSS|gn-aside|renderFooter|aboveMenuContent|renderContent|logo' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md | head -170; sed -n '1,110p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/types.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json | head -45; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | rg '/(House|Person|Gear|Bell|ShieldCheck|Envelope|ArrowUpFromLine|CircleQuestion|ChevronDown|ChevronRight|Folder|LayoutCells|Magnifier|Globe|CircleCheck|Lock|Bars|ArrowRightFromSquare|ArrowUpRightFromSquare|Sliders|Circles3Plus|Plus|Xmark)\\.' | head -40"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '510,565p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Modal/Modal.d.ts | head -100; rg -n 'Check|Moon|Sun' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts | head -12; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/AvatarText/types.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/AvatarImage/types.d.ts; rg -n -- '--g-text-input-|--g-text-area-' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.css | cut -c 1-900"

/bin/bash -lc "mkdir -p public && node --input-type=module -e 'import{writeFile}from\"node:fs/promises\";try{const r=await fetch(\"https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1500648767791-00dcc994a43e?w=240&h=240&fit=crop&crop=faces&q=85\");if(r.ok)await writeFile(\"public/avatar.jpg\",Buffer.from(await r.arrayBuffer()));}catch{}'"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '538,566p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md; rg -n -- '--gn-aside-header-(expanded-width|min-width|background-color|item.*color|item.*background)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md; rg -n 'onOpenChange|aria-labelledby' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Modal/Modal.d.ts | head -8; rg -n 'as\\??:|id\\??:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module -e 'import{stat,readFile}from\"node:fs/promises\";for(const path of [\"public/avatar.jpg\",\"public/avatar-fallback.svg\"]){console.log(path,(await stat(path)).size,\"bytes\")};const s=await readFile(\"node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.css\",\"utf8\");console.log([...new Set(s.match(/--gn-[a-z-]*(?:width|size)/g))].join(\"\\n\"));const a=await readFile(\"node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/Avatar.css\",\"utf8\");console.log(a.slice(0,1700))'"

/bin/bash -lc "git diff --stat && git status --short && rg -n -- '--g-avatar|width:|height:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/Avatar.css | head -35 && rg -n -- '--gn-aside-header-(expanded-width|min-width|size)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeaderContext.js node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/PageLayout.js node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/*.js | head -15 && rg -n -- '--g-button-justify-content' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.css && rg -n -- '--g-text-display-1-font-size|--g-spacing-9|--g-spacing-10' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/themes/_typography.scss node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/themes/_spacing.scss"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -- '--g-button-[a-z-]*:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.css | head -20; rg -n 'justify-content|text-align' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.css; rg -n -- '--gn-aside-header-expanded-width|--gn-aside-header-min-width' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/density.js; rg -n -- '--g-text-display-1-font-size|--g-spacing-9|--g-spacing-10' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/*.css | cut -c 1-150 | head -6; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts | head -45"
